title: Only Optimized/Mostly Optimized (QUILT)
description: Only Optimized/Mostly Optimized is a modpack that has no extra features so is great to create as a template if you want to make something with more features. supports 1.21.9 (1.21.10 + earlier versions coming soon!)
body:
# Features
Only Optimized/Mostly Optimized is a modpack with no extra quality of life features so acts great as a template to use whenever you want to make a new instance with more features. You can also use Only Optimized/Mostly Optimized as vanilla minecraft because it adds absolutly nothing to the game execpt higher performance. It has features like having less lag spikes, smoother FPS, improving mob AI, more optimized block ticking, dynamic FPS, and more! Thank you to [Simply Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop) for the inspiration.
